question: QL on Ozempic pens?
assumption: NY Medicaid/NYRx, because the question asks a coverage/QL item and no program was named.
answer: Assuming NY Medicaid/NYRx: **Ozempic® pen is preferred** in the GLP-1 Type 2 Diabetes class and the PDL row does **not** carry an F/Q/D (QL) flag. The GLP-1 class has **CC**: confirm an FDA-approved/compendia-supported and Medicaid-covered indication; PA is required if the patient is using a GLP-1 with a DPP-IV concurrently. The documents do not state a specific Ozempic pen quantity limit. NYRx notes preferred drugs can still be subject to F/Q/D edits, so if the claim rejects for QL/F/Q/D, follow the claim messaging or call the NY Medicaid Clinical Call Center: **877-309-9493**.

[p 14]
Prescription, non-prescription drugs, and medical/surgical supplies may have fixed limits in the amount and/or frequency that can be dispensed. NY Medicaid considers Frequency, Quantity, and Duration (F/Q/D) recommendations made by the Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Board. Some of the drugs/drug classes affected by F/Q/D editing are also included in the Preferred Drug Program (PDP). Therefore, drugs/drug classes that have a preferred status can also be subject to F/Q/D editing.
